gaps: The catalog cannot verify that the exact bid amounts 100 and 90 remain unchanged across both layouts; expect_responses verifies response columns and participation but not bid values.

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen without searching the events list.
Establish that both RFQ bids are initially visible.
Switch the Responses grid to the vertical layout.
Verify both response columns remain visible after the vertical layout change.
Switch the Responses grid to the horizontal layout.
Verify both response columns remain visible after the horizontal layout change.
